input.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short provision extending the Section 2 licences to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (with us remaining responsible for their compliance), since our playbook requires licence scope to cover affiliates and contractors and the current grant is limited to Corio alone. If Commerce One prefers, we can accept coverage of Affiliates upon written notice as a fallback.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. The licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, provided that Corio shall remain responsible for their compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement. For purposes of this Agreement, "AFFILIATE" means any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Corio, where "control" means direct or indirect ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting interests of such entity.
